261: On the seventh of the Holiday [Sukkot], it is the end of the [yearly] judgment of the world, and messages come out from the house of the King. So the restrictive powers [gevurot] are aroused and end on that day, and the willows of the brook are with (another version: depend upon) them. And we need to arouse the restrictive powers for water and to go around seven times, to sate the altar with the water of Issac, since this well of Issac's is filled with water. And when it is full, the whole world is blessed with water.
